derivation: Independently authored UTF-8 leading-byte counter, corpus and runners; no upstream implementation copied.
scope: Finite corpus of Unicode scalar strings, encoded as valid UTF-8, at most 1024 bytes. Counts bytes, code points and UTF-16 code units. Excludes lone surrogates, malformed UTF-8, normalization, grapheme clusters and display width. JavaScript observations execute Node.js built-in operations, with lone surrogates rejected before TextEncoder can replace them; no browser engine is tested.
runtime_identity: Record actual Go/Python and Node/V8/Unicode versions separately; documentation revisions do not substitute for executing runtime identities.
